method: Independent visual transcription, native PDF crops at 330-550 dpi, staff-line/accidental/stem inspection, and exhaustive PDF notehead-glyph count comparison.

conventions.beat: Zero-based quarter-beat offsets; every measure is 3/4. Exact rational strings are included.
conventions.pitch: Sounding MIDI, C4=60; all relevant 8va already applied. Do not apply global octave shifts again.
conventions.staff: Printed staff: 1 upper, 2 lower. Voices cross staves.
conventions.grace: grace:true with duration:0 denotes notation-only grace events anchored to beat; performance allocation remains unspecified.
conventions.ties: tieStart/tieStop mark only same-pitch ties. No phrase slurs are encoded as ties.
conventions.duration: Notated score duration; no invented pedal tails, arpeggio roll delays or rubato.
